title: Da Imperial Executors
wikitext: brief introduction == History == The clan was founded by [http://www.psychicreviewonline.com psychics]/span> [[Titan]], [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Kernel]] and [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Superman]] in [[1997]]. [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[HellAngel]] (who later changed name to Silver, Silver Fang and Siv) joined the crew soon after, giving the clan its first real lineup. The clan started as a Swedish QuakeWorld clan and made a name for itself soon after as some of the most notorious Scandinavian QuakeWorld players in the game's history joined the clan throughout time. However, as new games were released and the activity in the QuakeWorld scene slowly decreased, various core players either left to play other games or changed to different clans.
